items.question: Does this work for my industry?
items.answer: Yes. We look at processes, not industries. If your business handles inquiries, customer communication, or routine operations, we can work together.

items.question: What do I get out of the call?
items.answer: You'll see clearly which parts of your work can be automated, how much time you'd get back, and what moving forward would look like. There's no charge.

items.question: We already have systems in place. Is that a problem?
items.answer: Not at all. We integrate with the tools you already use. You don't have to rebuild anything from scratch.

items.question: How long is the call?
items.answer: 30 minutes. You pick whatever time works from the calendar.

items.question: What happens if the AI gets something wrong?
items.answer: Critical steps always wait for your approval. The only things left fully automated are routine, repetitive tasks.
